verdict.rationale: Sketch's AI features (sketch-docs-14,15,26,27,39) cover contextual copy replacement, automatic layer organization, dark-mode conversion, and color-palette extraction from a photo, and it can connect to MCP AI clients for code generation—but there is no evidence of built-in image generation or background removal tools. missing for 10: image generation, background/foreground removal, content-aware fill (beyond text), independent hands-on verification of AI feature quality.
